reports.customersReportBlurb: New, returning and the biggest spenders
reports.promotionsReportBlurb: What each offer actually cost and returned
reports.inventoryReportBlurb: Low stock, and what it's all worth
reports.rangeIsCairo: Dates are Cairo days. Revenue counts an order on the day it was delivered.
reports.revenueIsDelivered: Delivered orders only — cancelled and returned are excluded.
reports.placedNotDelivered: Counted on the day they were placed
reports.noDataInRange: Nothing to show for this period.
reports.axisInPounds: The vertical axis is in pounds, up to {max}.
reports.productRevenueExcludesDelivery: Product and category revenue is goods only — the delivery fee belongs to the order, not to any one line.
reports.categoryUsesCurrentCategory: Grouped by each product's current category, so a product moved between categories takes its history with it.
reports.promotionsFromPlacement: Taken from the promotion recorded on each order line when it was placed, not from re-running today's rules.
reports.newMeansFirstEver: "New" means their first order ever fell in this period — not their first order within it.
reports.lowStockThreshold: Products with 50 or fewer in stock.
reports.marginUsesCurrentCost: Margin uses each product's current cost price — the only cost the system stores. A cost that changed after a sale makes these figures approximate.
reports.missingCostCountsAsZero: A product with no cost recorded counts as zero cost, so its margin is overstated. Worth recording.
